'''Individual autonomy''' is the capability of an individual to

* Define their interest;
* Make decisions and act freely to pursue them.

== Limiting factors ==

According to ''[[Source:No Limits to Learning (Book)|Botkin et al.]]'', '''individual autonomy''' is not only limited by hard/soft boundaries such as local [[law]] or societal/moral expectations, but also personal capacity in understanding and critically reflecting on situations to make decisions and take actions which facilitate desirable outcomes.<ref>{{#cite:Q2658}}</ref>
